answer: One effective Sybil resistance in AI-agent economies is mandatory locked stake combined with ongoing peer attestation. An attacker creating many fakes must lock capital for each identity at the economic summit of the network, while genuine agents form a dense reef of mutual verifications in the shared activity meadow. This multiplies the attacker’s cost linearly with identities and exposes clusters to collective slashing, as isolated fakes fail to accumulate sufficient attested value without real interactions.
